description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Http, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Request to handle XML-RPC requests received via HTTP. It includes methods for retrieving raw XML, headers, and the full HTTP request, and constructs the object by reading raw POST data.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Http
classes.description: Handles XML-RPC requests over HTTP, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Request, with methods to access raw XML, headers, and full request data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Reads raw POST data from php://input, sets fault if data is invalid, and loads XML.

methods.name: getRawRequest
methods.description: Returns the raw XML request received.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all HTTP headers as key-value pairs.

methods.name: getFullRequest
methods.description: Returns the full HTTP request including headers and XML.
